spec.name: Orange Kitchen Mixing Bowl
spec.description: A honey-oak kitchen cabinet with inset doors, an ivory worktop, and a large open terracotta mixing bowl with a creamy glazed interior. Stepped bowl walls and a wooden spoon resting across its rim create a readable kitchen silhouette. Front faces -Z; cabinet footprint is 16×16, with its feet grounded at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Mixing Bowl. Cozy kitchen cabinet supporting a large open glazed ceramic mixing bowl and a wooden spoon resting across its rim. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
